materials_exhausted.note: Reopened the handoff packet, XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package, supplementary ZIP/PDF via pdftotext, locator index, and linked DBAASP rows. No blocking locally recoverable source gap remains; exact supplementary figure curve series are not tabulated and are not promoted.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the table-axis activity interpretation, reconciled all linked DBAASP rows against Table 1/2/3 and article metadata, preserved Rosetta-vs-DBAASP strain-label conflicts as cautions, and replaced automated mechanism placeholders with bounded ribosome/translation/uptake claims. The paper is publication-grade as accepted_with_cautions, not accepted_clean.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Table 1 supports peptide identities and Table 2/3 support linked MIC values. DBAASP rows naming Rosetta DE3 pLysS as BL21(DE3) plysS are retained as source_conflict with matching MIC values; all other linked assay/experiment/literature rows are source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows now preserve peptide as entity, E. coli strain as target, MIC value/unit, medium, and source locator. No local toxicity endpoint was found, so toxicity remains an explicit absence rather than a fabricated record.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is limited to ribosome binding/translation inhibition plus uptake/SbmA context. The source does not resolve a single Api805 binding site, so that uncertainty is preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: The local supplementary ZIP contains one PDF. It supports methods, p-value tables, and figure captions but not raw curve tables; exact figure-series values are not promoted.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Twelve linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows match Table 2 MIC values but label the Rosetta DE3 pLysS source column as BL21(DE3) plysS. These rows remain source_conflict instead of being silently normalized.
The paper supports ribosome-associated translation inhibition but states the known PrAMP binding sites do not explain Api805; final mechanism avoids single-site assignment.
Supplementary PDF was recovered and checked; no tabulated raw figure curve values were available locally, and none are promoted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The recovered supplementary file is a PDF with text, p-value tables, and embedded figures, but no tabulated raw fluorescence-polarization, translation, uptake, or degradation curve series.
